text: The purpose of this report is to seek Board approval for a bargaining mandate with IATSE Local 58.

The Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Authorized the bargaining mandate with IATSE Local 58, as noted in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (November 6, 2019) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (November 6, 2019) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live remain confidential in its entirety, as it relates to labour relations information or employee negotiations.
